explanation: This unit tracks the agent's current a2-vs-a1 preference: at D2 it is almost always 9-10 (7-8 only after a common a1 trial), and while the agent keeps choosing a2 every D1 and GO step stays at 10 no matter the rewards or transitions. When the agent is choosing a1, GO drops to 0-1 (up to about 4 during long runs of rewarded a1-to-S1 trials), and D1 sits around 0-3 (0-1 after an unrewarded common a1 trial, 3-6 after a rewarded rare trial), but it climbs back to 9-10 in long rewarded a1 streaks and in the first trials after switching back to a2.
